name: @hwpforge/mcp

tools.name: hwpforge_convert
tools.description: Convert Markdown to a Korean HWPX document (KS X 6101 standard). Supports GFM tables, images, headings, and Korean typography. Returns the output file path and document summary.

markdown.description: Markdown file path or inline content.

is_file.description: Whether `markdown` is a file path (true) or inline content (false). Default: true.

output_path.description: Output HWPX file path. Must end with `.hwpx`.

tools.name: hwpforge_delete_para
tools.description: Delete top-level body paragraphs by index, all-or-nothing, preserving every other byte. Fail-closed: refuses a paragraph carrying a reference (bookmark/cross-ref/footnote/…), a hard page/column break, the section properties (the first paragraph), or that would empty the section. Only round-trip-safe inputs are editable: a document whose ZIP entries the encoder cannot all carry — a document saved by Hancom, which adds Preview/* and META-INF/container.rdf — is refused here, while hwpforge_to_json + hwpforge_patch (text) and hwpforge_fill (click-here fields) still accept it. Verify the result with hwpforge_diff.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to edit.

tools.name: hwpforge_diff
tools.description: Compare two HWPX files. semantic channel = decoded Core structure classified into field values, table-cell text {table,row,col}, paragraph text {section,para}, structure counts, and a capped unclassified remainder; package channel = ZIP entries compared by bytes. Run after hwpforge_fill / hwpforge_set_cell / hwpforge_stamp / hwpforge_patch to confirm only the intended delta landed. Wire content inside a changed entry (e.g. layout caches) is not itemized — the report states its comparison levels explicitly.

base_path.description: Path to the base HWPX file.

revised_path.description: Path to the revised HWPX file.

output_path.description:
Optional path for the full pretty-printed JSON report. Required when
the report exceeds the 1 MB inline ceiling.

tools.name: hwpforge_fields
tools.description: List named click-here fields (누름틀) in an HWPX document: name, hint, current value, and whether each is fillable. Use before hwpforge_fill to discover field names.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to inspect.

tools.name: hwpforge_fill
tools.description: Fill named click-here fields (누름틀) by name→value map, byte-preserving everything else. All values are validated first (all-or-nothing). Much cheaper than to_json+patch for template filling. Use hwpforge_fields to discover names.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to fill.

values.description:
Field name → value map. All values are validated before anything is
written (all-or-nothing). Use hwpforge_fields to discover names.

output_path.description: Output HWPX file path. Must end with `.hwpx`.

tools.name: hwpforge_from_json
tools.description: Create an HWPX document directly from a JSON structure (ExportedDocument schema). Use when building documents programmatically without Markdown. Get the schema from hwpforge_to_json output. For large documents, prefer hwpforge_to_json + hwpforge_patch workflow with file paths instead of inline JSON.

structure.description:
JSON string matching the ExportedDocument schema.
Use hwpforge_to_json output as a reference for the structure.

output_path.description: Output HWPX file path. Must end with `.hwpx`.

tools.name: hwpforge_insert_para
tools.description: Insert new top-level paragraphs before or after an anchor paragraph, preserving every other byte: text for one paragraph, or texts for a contiguous block inserted in order in one verified edit. Each new paragraph inherits the anchor's paragraph and character shape (no style is invented); every entry is a single line of plain text. Insert-before the section's first paragraph is refused. Only round-trip-safe inputs are editable: a document whose ZIP entries the encoder cannot all carry — a document saved by Hancom, which adds Preview/* and META-INF/container.rdf — is refused here, while hwpforge_to_json + hwpforge_patch (text) and hwpforge_fill (click-here fields) still accept it. Verify with hwpforge_diff.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to edit.

anchor.description: Anchor paragraph index (the new paragraph inherits its shape).

before.description: Insert before the anchor instead of after.

text.description:
Plain text of the new paragraph (single line). Provide exactly one of
`text` or `texts`.

texts.description:
Plain texts of a contiguous block of new paragraphs (one single-line
entry per paragraph, inserted in order in one verified edit). Provide
exactly one of `text` or `texts`.

tools.name: hwpforge_inspect
tools.description: Inspect an HWPX document structure. Returns section count, paragraph counts, tables, images, charts, headers, footers, page numbers per section, and any decode warnings. A count's prefix names its scope: unprefixed keys are top-level only, `all_*` counts objects anywhere in the section including captions but not master pages, and `deep_*` counts paragraphs recursing into table cells, text boxes, notes and memos. The scopes can disagree on documents with nested content.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to inspect.

styles.description: Reserved for future use. When true, will include style details. Currently ignored.

tools.name: hwpforge_outline
tools.description: Show the document navigation map for an HWPX file: headings (level + text), tables (ordinal + logical grid dims + addressable), named click-here fields, and bookmarks. Name anchors are the primary keys; {section, para} locators are secondary and go stale after structural edits. Fetch this once before targeted reads or edits.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to map.

tools.name: hwpforge_patch
tools.description: Replace a section in an existing HWPX file with edited JSON data. Preserves images and styles from the base file. Use after hwpforge_to_json for surgical edits. Text-only: the edited JSON must keep the section's paragraph structure — a replacement whose semantic text slots differ in count or path is refused. Add or remove paragraphs with hwpforge_insert_para / hwpforge_delete_para, change table cells with hwpforge_set_cell, and rebuild a restructured document with hwpforge_from_json.

base_path.description: Path to the base HWPX file.

section_json_path.description: Path to the JSON file containing the replacement section.

tools.name: hwpforge_read
tools.description: Read a targeted text projection without exporting the whole document. Exactly one target: section (paragraph range via optional paras "A..B") for text with outline/list kinds; table (ordinal) for the logical grid text matrix (merged regions appear once at their anchor with spans); field (name) for a named click-here field. Non-text content surfaces as explicit markers. Read-only: to change what you read, use hwpforge_fill / hwpforge_set_cell / hwpforge_patch.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to read.

section.description:
Section index to read paragraphs from (exactly one of
section/table/field).

paras.description: Inclusive paragraph range "A..B" or a single "N" (requires section).

table.description: Table ordinal to read as a grid text matrix.

tools.name: hwpforge_restyle
tools.description: Apply a different style template (preset) to an existing HWPX document. Replaces fonts and paragraph styles while preserving document content and structure. Use hwpforge_templates to discover available presets.

file_path.description: Path to the source HWPX file.

preset.description: Style preset name to apply. Use hwpforge_templates to see available presets.

output_path.description: Output HWPX file path. Must end with `.hwpx`.

tools.name: hwpforge_set_cell
tools.description: Edit table cells by logical grid address in an HWPX file. Address a cell with a table ordinal (to-json export order) plus at {row,col} (covered positions resolve to their merge anchor), right_of LABEL, or below LABEL (normalized exact match). Empty text clears the cell. All-or-nothing behind the fail-closed admission gate; cells containing tables/images/controls are rejected. The gate also refuses a document whose ZIP entries the encoder cannot all carry — a document saved by Hancom, which adds Preview/* and META-INF/container.rdf — while hwpforge_to_json + hwpforge_patch (text) and hwpforge_fill (click-here fields) still accept it.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to edit.

specs.description:
Cell edits: each spec addresses a table by ordinal (to-json export
order) plus one of `at` {row,col} (covered positions resolve to their
merge anchor), `right_of` LABEL, or `below` LABEL (normalized exact
match). `text` "" clears the cell. All-or-nothing.

output_path.description: Output HWPX file path. Must end with `.hwpx`.

table.description: Table ordinal in the shared traversal order (see `to-json` export).

text.description: Replacement text; the empty string clears the cell.

oneOf.description: A logical grid coordinate (covered positions resolve to their anchor).
The cell immediately right of the uniquely labeled cell.
The cell immediately below the uniquely labeled cell.

GridCoord.description: Absolute position on the pre-merge logical grid, zero-based.

tools.name: hwpforge_stamp
tools.description: Promote prose placeholders to named click-here fields (누름틀) using the approved spec list from hwpforge_stamp_plan. Fail-closed admission gate (lossless round-trip + ZIP closed-world) + all-or-nothing preflight; writes the stamped HWPX and a manifest. The gate refuses a document whose ZIP entries the encoder cannot all carry — a document saved by Hancom, which adds Preview/* and META-INF/container.rdf — while hwpforge_to_json + hwpforge_patch (text) and hwpforge_fill (click-here fields) still accept it. The output is immediately usable with hwpforge_fields/hwpforge_fill.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to stamp.

specs.description:
Approved text specs: one per candidate from hwpforge_stamp_plan.
Copy the candidate object unchanged — `section`, `path`, `span` and
`marker` are its identity and are re-verified against the document —
and add `action` ({"field":{"name":"…"}} or "ignore"). Every
unguarded candidate must be covered (all-or-nothing).

cells.description:
Approved cell specs (class-B, from hwpforge_stamp_plan `cells`).
Build each one from the candidate's `table` and `at` plus `action`;
optionally add `label` {at, text} to re-claim one of the candidate's
labels. No other candidate field is accepted here. Field actions
REQUIRE a non-blank hint; presence of any cell spec requires
`source_sha256`.

source_sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the input from hwpforge_stamp_plan — mandatory with
`cells` (drift pinning); selects the v2 pipeline when present.

output_path.description: Output HWPX file path. Must end with `.hwpx`.

StampSpec.description:
One approved candidate: identity (section/path/span/marker) + action.

Identity must match a live plan candidate exactly — a stale span or
edited document fails preflight instead of stamping the wrong text.

span.description: UTF-8 byte span within the slot text (from [`StampCandidate::span`]).

marker.description: Original marker text, verified against the document.

action.description: What to do with this candidate.

StampAction.description:
Caller decision for one candidate (design §3-3: the caller map is the
only source of final field names — no auto-derived names, no suffixes).

oneOf.description: Promote to a named ClickHere field.

name.description: Unique field name (unique across specs AND existing fields).

hint.description: Optional hint; defaults to the original marker text.

CellStampSpec.description: One approved class-B target: identity + drift claim + action.

table.description: Table ordinal in shared inventory (DFS pre-order) document order.

at.description:
Canonical anchor coordinate of the target cell (covered coordinates
are rejected at preflight, never silently resolved).

label.description: Label drift claim; `None` marks an explicit orphan target.

action.description: What to do with this target.

GridCoord.description: Absolute position on the pre-merge logical grid, zero-based.

CellLabelClaim.description:
Drift re-verification claim for a detected candidate's label.

Present on specs approving a detected candidate: preflight re-checks
that the label cell at `at` still normalize-matches `text`. Absent for
explicit (caller-authored) orphan targets.

at.description: Anchor coordinate of the label cell.

text.description: Label text as reported by plan (compared normalized).

CellStampAction.description:
Caller decision for one class-B cell target.

Unlike class-A [`StampAction`](super::StampAction), the `hint` is
**required**: a canonical
empty cell carries no marker text, so the unfilled field body must come
from the caller (see module docs).

oneOf.description: Promote the cell content to a named ClickHere field.

name.description:
Unique field name (unique across text+cell specs AND existing
fields).

hint.description: Unfilled field body and hint (must not be blank).

tools.name: hwpforge_stamp_plan
tools.description: Discover class-A placeholder candidates (checkbox/paren-blank/date-blank/standalone-@/seal tokens) in an HWPX for template stamping. Author one spec per candidate (field name or ignore) and pass them to hwpforge_stamp. Guarded candidates (instruction context) are never auto-applied.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to inspect for placeholder candidates.

tools.name: hwpforge_templates
tools.description: List available style presets (templates) for HWPX document generation. Returns preset names, descriptions, fonts, and page sizes. Call before hwpforge_convert to choose a preset.

name.description: Filter by preset name. Omit to list all presets.

tools.name: hwpforge_to_json
tools.description: Export HWPX to JSON for editing. Use section parameter (0-based) to extract a single section for token efficiency. Returns JSON inline while the serialized response stays under 1 MB — the document JSON is escaped into a string field, so the effective document-JSON limit is content-dependent and below 1 MB (typically ~750-800 KB); larger exports are rejected with OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE — or writes to file with output_path.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to export.

section.description: Extract only a specific section (0-based index). Omit for full document.

output_path.description: Output JSON file path. If omitted, returns JSON inline.

tools.name: hwpforge_to_md
tools.description: Convert an HWPX document to Markdown. Extracts text, headings, tables, and images from the HWPX file. Returns the path to the generated Markdown file and any extracted image files.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to convert.

output_dir.description:
Output directory for the generated Markdown and image files.
Defaults to the same directory as the input file.

tools.name: hwpforge_validate
tools.description: Validate an HWPX file structure and integrity. Returns validation status, section/paragraph counts, any issues found, and any decode warnings (present whether or not the document validated). A file that cannot even be decoded (wrong format, corrupt package — for example a .hwp file) is reported as a DECODE_FAILED error, not as an invalid document. Use to verify files before editing or after generation.

file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to validate.

instructions: HwpForge MCP server for Korean HWPX document generation and editing. Converts Markdown to HWPX, inspects document structure, and supports JSON round-trip editing. Use hwpforge_templates to discover available style templates before creating documents. Resources provide style template details. Prompts guide document creation workflows.
